subject.title: feat(dashboard): expose apply lane health telemetry

question: Should ClawSweeper add this bounded apply-lane health surface to the production Overview after the contributor supplies live lifecycle proof?
rationale: The patch adds a new operator-facing dashboard capability and workflow producer, so passing tests alone cannot establish whether this operational surface and its retained semantics are the desired long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor bounded telemetry
options.body: Accept the dashboard-local apply health card once redacted proof confirms a real start and terminal observation are correctly represented.

options.title: Keep telemetry out of Overview
options.body: Decline the new dashboard surface and retain existing apply/state diagnostics until a narrower operational need is agreed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded telemetry
recommendation.body: Accept the dashboard-local apply health card once redacted proof confirms a real start and terminal observation are correctly represented.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged apply-lane work makes this person the strongest available history-based candidate to decide the lifecycle boundary.
